results.content:
# CollectivIQ launches AI workers for workplace roles  
Wed, 12th Aug 2026 (Yesterday)  
[SEAN MITCHELL Publisher](https://cfotech.news/author/sean-mitchell)  
CollectivIQ has launched Digital Direct Reports, an AI feature that assigns software agents to defined workplace roles. The product is available within the company's platform.  
The Boston-based company said the feature is intended to let organisations deploy AI workers for roles such as project management, executive support, software engineering, recruitment and data work. Unlike general AI assistants, each agent is assigned a specific function and can operate across the business software employees already use.  
Each Digital Direct Report is given a first and last name and configured with tools, permissions and knowledge tied to a particular role. These AI workers can retain context over time, collaborate with one another and carry out tasks within existing workflows, rather than only responding to prompts in a chat window.  
The launch reflects a broader shift in corporate AI use, from question-and-answer tools to software that can manage recurring work. Businesses have been experimenting with AI assistants for drafting text, summarising meetings and retrieving information, but suppliers are increasingly trying to persuade customers to hand over more routine operational tasks to automated systems.
Digital Direct Reports connects with Microsoft 365, Teams, Outlook, OneDrive, Atlassian Jira, Confluence and GitHub. In practice, that means an AI worker assigned to a project team could monitor progress in Jira, coordinate schedules, prepare updates and gather information from company files and communications.  
CollectivIQ also outlined examples for other roles. An executive assistant version could manage calendars, summarise meetings, draft emails and identify priorities. Engineering-focused agents could work with GitHub repositories and support software development processes, while human resources and recruiting agents could organise candidate information and assist with hiring administration.  
The system keeps humans involved in approvals where needed and records activity for audit purposes. Organisations can also monitor how AI workers interact with internal systems and data, a point likely to matter to companies concerned about security, oversight and accountability as they expand AI use.  
According to CollectivIQ, the feature has already been tested within Buyers Edge Platform, the foodservice procurement and technology company whose leadership team also founded CollectivIQ. It also cited an early use case at Mohegan Gaming.  
**Executive view**  
John Davie, Chief Executive Officer of CollectivIQ, set out the company's case for a broader role for AI in office work.
CollectivIQ positions itself as a platform that brings together multiple large language models in one system for business intelligence use. With this release, it is extending that approach from analysis and responses into delegated workplace functions. The main test will be whether companies trust AI workers with ongoing responsibilities inside their own software environments.

# CollectivIQ Launches New Class of AI Teammates That Take on Real Business Roles  
PR Newswire  
BOSTON, Aug. 12, 2026  
*New Digital Direct Reports Capability Enables Organizations to Hire Specialized AI Employees That Collaborate, Remember Context, Connect to Enterprise Systems, and Complete Work Across Departments*  
BOSTON, Aug. 12, 2026 /PRNewswire/ — [CollectivIQ](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4751053-1&h=1584102603&u=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.collectiviq.ai%2F&a=CollectivIQ), the world’s first AI consensus platform for business intelligence, today announced the launch of **Digital Direct Reports (DDRs)**, a first-of-its-kind capability that enables employees to hire AI teammates for specific roles across their organization. Unlike general-purpose AI agents that answer questions or take on specific tasks, Digital Direct Reports are role-based AI employees designed to own business functions and responsibilities, connect to business systems, and complete work alongside human teams.
Unlike traditional AI assistants that start fresh with every conversation, each Digital Direct Report maintains persistent context about its responsibilities, previous work, and user preferences. This continuity enables DDRs to become increasingly effective over time while preserving organizational knowledge and reducing repetitive work.  
Digital Direct Reports are also designed with enterprise governance in mind. Actions can require approvals when appropriate, activity is auditable, and organizations maintain visibility into how AI teammates interact with company systems and data.  
The launch builds on CollectivIQ’s mission to help enterprises harness intelligent, honest AI at the best value. The platform already enables users to leverage multiple leading AI models through a single platform. Digital Direct Reports extend that vision by moving beyond AI conversations to AI collaboration, allowing organizations to delegate meaningful work to specialized AI teammates while employees focus on higher-value decision-making.  
Digital Direct Reports are available today within the CollectivIQ platform.

results.name: CollectivIQ: A startup que une múltiplos modelos de IA para eliminar alucinações e aumentar a precisão | WeZ | Agência Digital
results.content:
A busca por confiabilidade no campo da inteligência artificial generativa levou à criação da **CollectivIQ**, uma startup que propõe uma abordagem colaborativa entre chatbots para entregar resultados superiores. Em vez de depender de um único motor, a ferramenta consulta simultaneamente sistemas como **ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude e Grok**, além de outros 10 modelos. O objetivo central é mitigar o problema das **alucinações** — respostas incorretas ou inventadas — ao cruzar dados de diversas fontes para gerar uma resposta consolidada e verificada.
## Como funciona a fusão de modelos  
O diferencial tecnológico da **CollectivIQ** reside em sua capacidade de identificar sobreposições e divergências entre as respostas de diversos modelos em tempo real. O software busca por informações convergentes para produzir uma **resposta fundida**, projetada para ser mais precisa do que qualquer modelo individual poderia oferecer sozinho.
## Modelo de Negócio Flexível  
Diferente de outros serviços que exigem assinaturas anuais pesadas e de longo prazo, a startup opera sob um modelo de **pagamento por uso (pay-per-usage)**. A empresa utiliza APIs empresariais e cobra conforme a demanda do cliente, permitindo que as organizações paguem apenas pelo valor real que extraem da ferramenta. Essa flexibilidade é vista como um diferencial crucial em um mercado saturado de soluções rígidas.  
Lançada inicialmente para uso interno no início de 2026, a plataforma foi aberta ao público após a percepção de que o mercado enfrentava as mesmas hesitações na adoção de IA. Atualmente operando com capital próprio, a startup planeja buscar investimento externo para expandir sua atuação e continuar o desenvolvimento de ferramentas que unifiquem o que há de melhor no ecossistema de **Inteligência Artificial**.
